title: X-ray: Generate and Analyse (XGA)
description: X-ray: Generate and Analyse (XGA) provides a Python interface to high-energy astrophysics data product generation and analysis, enabling large scale interactive/scripted exploration of X-ray sources. XMM, eROSITA, and Chandra (partial) are supported. Product classes provide powerful Python interfaces with high-energy data products.
